name: Listen Together
description:
Watch a film together, each with your own headphones. Listen Together plays the sound of your computer in two or more Bluetooth headsets or speakers at once, of any brand, mixed freely.

HOW IT WORKS
Connect two (or more) Bluetooth audio devices. A Share Audio tile appears in Quick Settings; click it and the sound plays in all of them. Click again to go back to the output you had before. The tile is only there while at least two Bluetooth audio devices are connected, and nothing is added to the top bar. Each device has its own volume slider.

NOTHING TO INSTALL
No helper program, no password, no configuration file. The extension uses PipeWire's own combine-stream module, which ships with every PipeWire desktop, and removes its virtual output as soon as sharing stops. Audio keeps playing while the screen is locked, which is why the extension stays enabled on the lock screen.

LIMITS
Different models do not play a sound after exactly the same time, so they can be slightly apart; each device has a delay slider to line them up by ear, remembered per device. All the devices share one Bluetooth radio: with a weak adapter or busy 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, short dropouts can happen. Sharing ends by itself when a device disconnects or when you pick another output.
